scenarios.title: Industrial-classified critical anomaly
scenarios.summary: A high-confidence industrial source reaches Model C critical severity.
talk_track: Start before the focal day and play forward.
Open the focal site when the critical marker appears.
Explain that identity, temporal behavior, and anomaly severity remain separate signals.

scenarios.title: Industrial reactivation after dormancy
scenarios.summary: An industrial-classified source returns after a long inactive gap and is anomalous.
talk_track: Play from the beginning to show the dormant interval ending.
Use Model B to explain reactivation and Model C to explain unusual intensity.
Emphasize that the alert is generated by the frozen deterministic policy.

scenarios.title: Unclassified critical review
scenarios.summary: A promoted source is statistically critical but remains UNKNOWN rather than being called industrial.
talk_track: Show that a strong anomaly does not fabricate industrial identity.
Open the evidence tab to demonstrate the analyst-review workflow.
Keep the claim at urgent unclassified-source review.

scenarios.title: Nonindustrial anomaly contrast
scenarios.summary: A critical site-relative thermal score remains nonindustrial under Model A classification.
talk_track: Contrast anomaly magnitude with source identity.
Explain why Model C does not override Model A into an industrial claim.
Use this case to demonstrate conservative decision-support behavior.
